exams_dates_chk.name: exams_dates_chk
exams_dates_chk.value: "exams"."start_date" IS NULL OR "exams"."end_date" IS NULL OR "exams"."end_date" >= "exams"."start_date"

exam_papers_marks_chk.name: exam_papers_marks_chk
